Test Case 1: Valid Login - Success Case

Input:
- Email: test@example.com
- Password: correct-password

Expected Stages (in order):
1. AUTH_START - Entry point with sanitized email
2. DB_QUERY_USER_START - Query initiation with full query text
3. DB_QUERY_USER_COMPLETE - Query result with execution_time_ms, result_count
4. USER_FOUND - User parsed successfully with user_id, parsing_path
5. PASSWORD_VERIFY_START - Password verification initiation
6. PASSWORD_VERIFY_COMPLETE - Password verification result with verification_time_ms
7. TOKEN_CREATE_START - JWT token creation initiation
8. TOKEN_CREATE_COMPLETE - Token created with expires_in
9. DB_UPDATE_LOGIN_TIME - Last login timestamp updated
10. DB_QUERY_ORGANIZATIONS_START - Query user organizations
11. DB_QUERY_ORGANIZATIONS_COMPLETE - Organizations fetched with org_count
12. AUTH_SUCCESS - Final success with total_duration_ms

Expected Output:
- HTTP Status: 200 OK
- Response contains: token, refresh_token, user object, organizations array
- X-Correlation-ID header present
- All logs have same correlation_id
- AUTH_SUCCESS log contains: user_id, org_count, total_duration_ms

Validation Checks:
✓ Correlation ID in response header
✓ All logs have same correlation_id
✓ All expected stages present in logs
✓ AUTH_START has email (sanitized)
✓ DB_QUERY_USER_COMPLETE has execution_time_ms and result_count
✓ PASSWORD_VERIFY_COMPLETE has verification_time_ms
✓ AUTH_SUCCESS has user_id, org_count, total_duration_ms
✓ No AUTH_FAILURE stage present
